## Description

⌘K / Ctrl+K overlay: search name, MRN, phone. Results show initials + age + MRN tail until opened. Patients outside the user's care relationship show "Request access" (in clinics: request to owner; hospitals: break-glass in P7). Actions: Open chart · Start visit · Book.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Results never include full names or identifiers before a record is opened (payload test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Opening a patient without a care relationship is blocked and offers Request access; the request is audited and notifies the owner.
- [ ] **AC3.** Keyboard: open with ⌘K/Ctrl+K, arrow navigation, Enter to open, Esc to close; screen-reader announcements.
- [ ] **AC4.** p95 search latency < 300 ms.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
